paragraphs: The X3 M40i uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six petrol engine. It was fitted across the G01 generation from 2017 to 2024, positioned as the performance-oriented petrol option below the full-fat X3 M. The B58 is a well-regarded engine in BMW's modular B-series family, known for its smooth power delivery and robust design.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 M40i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
